rotowire.headline: Jackson (ankle) was a full participant at Thursday's practice, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.
rotowire.story: Jackson seems on track to return to action for Sunday's game at Buffalo after logging back-to-back uncapped sessions to begin Week 8 prep. Ultimately, Friday's injury report will reveal if he's tagged with a designation for that matchup, but the quarterback is seeking his first game action since Week 4, when he initially suffered a left high-ankle sprain.
rotowire.description: Jackson (ankle) was a full participant at Thursday's practice, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

rotowire.headline: Doncic (back) will play in Friday's game against the Warriors.
rotowire.story: Doncic was held out of Wednesday's game against the Clippers after logging 37 minutes in the first half of the back-to-back Tuesday. However, he'll be a full go for Friday's clash. The star guard has been on a tear to begin the 2026-27 season, averaging 36.0 points, 6.8 rebounds, 8.3 assists and 1.3 steals in four appearances.
rotowire.description: Doncic (back) will play in Friday's game against the Warriors.
